steps.en: Deploy Kong in front of all your backend services
steps.zh: 部署 Kong，放在所有后端服务前面

steps.en: Declare a Service + Route: which path goes to which backend
steps.zh: 声明 Service + Route：哪条路径转给哪个后端

steps.en: Attach bundled plugins to the route and set their parameters
steps.zh: 给路由挂上现成插件，填参数

steps.en: A request enters on :8000 and is matched to a route
steps.zh: 请求从 :8000 进门，匹配到路由

steps.en: Runs that route's plugins in order; any plugin can reject the request
steps.zh: 按顺序跑这条路由上的插件，任一不放行就直接拒绝

steps.en: If all pass, proxies to the backend and records metrics
steps.zh: 全部放行后转发给后端，同时记下指标

value.en: Auth, rate limiting and monitoring happen once at the door — backends stop reimplementing them
value.zh: 鉴权、限流、监控在门口统一做掉，后端服务不用各写一份
